notes: «ح» splits two routes; «قالا حدثنا وكيع» (dual) is the one writing after both branches meet, so the names from Wakiʿ down to ʿAisha are the shared tail.
«أبيه» is Hisham's father, a bare relation; he is not named in the text.
The closing «هذا حديث وكيع» is a remark on the version and is not a route.
